decisions.reason: As a flagship click-in track adapter, it builds directly on the firm's strong knowledge in modular lighting systems and installer-friendly engineering, so management is likely to retain and refine it rather than withdraw it.
An LED luminaire line lies squarely within the firm's core lighting design and engineering capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback and improve the range.

The home automation server box is more knowledge-distant than the firm's core luminaires and, without visible in-house research depth or research partnerships, management is more likely to redeploy resources away from this harder-to-absorb product area.
A luminaire family matches the firm's existing premium lighting know-how, showroom selling model, and planner-installer network, making continued development and retention the more likely choice.
